Icelandic groundfish survey, March 2019, vessel tracks

Source: R/datasets.R
trawlsurvey.Rd

Each row is a position of one of four vessels on the Icelandic groundfish survey in March (SMB), 27 February to 20 March 2019, with whether a survey tow was on. Read it with rr_example("trawlsurvey").

Format

A parquet file of 8,918 rows in the package's extdata folder, trawlsurvey.parquet, with the columns:

  • vid: The vessel's Icelandic registry number.

  • lon: Longitude. Unit: degrees east.

  • lat: Latitude. Unit: degrees north.

  • speed: Speed over ground, knots. Unit: knots.

  • heading: Heading, degrees. Unit: degrees.

  • time: Time of the position, Icelandic time, which is UTC all year.

  • behaviour: Whether a survey tow was on. Values: hauling, not hauling.

Source

Marine and Freshwater Research Institute (2019). "Icelandic groundfish survey in March (SMB, Stofnmæling botnfiska á Íslandsmiðum), 2019: vessel tracks and tows." Extracted from MFRI's database by the ramb maintainer, https://www.hafogvatn.is.

Licence: MFRI data, shipped by its maintainer at MFRI; the terms are not stated here.

Details

extracted from MFRI's database (data-raw/DATASET.R).
